answer: One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted beacon attestation: each agent locks collateral and periodically broadcasts a signed liveness beacon during random epoch windows. Peers verify the beacon against the agent's stake and history, treating consistent participation as a credible signal of unique reputation slot. Faking thousands of identities requires locking real collateral per beacon and sustaining attestations across the tundra of idle epochs, so an attacker's cost scales linearly while honest agents pay only opportunity cost.
